context: Step 1 measured (PR #731, record hook-inputs-carry-token-counts): PreCompact and Stop inputs carry no token counts; only the statusLine input (interactive sessions only) has context_window.current_usage, equal to the transcript's last usage. Nothing splits fixed overhead (36.6k to 42.1k in this container) from messages.

options.gain: Works in cloud and local sessions alike.
options.how: Messages = last usage minus first-turn usage, read from the transcript in every session.
options.label: A proxy from the transcript
options.lose: A proxy, not an exact split.

options.how: Thresholds read current_usage where a statusLine runs.
options.label: statusLine's count only
options.lose: Cloud and non-interactive sessions get nothing.

options.label: Stop at step 1
